lines.text:
Oh, are you on your way to
the Pokémon League?\c
Well, I’m in the middle of my patrol, but I bet
a bit of encouragement from a beautiful
police officer will help you!
Oh, you must be exhausted!\nDo you want me to heal you up?
There you go!\nYou’re ready to face anything now!
Don’t worry. I know you can handle anything!\nJust don’t give up, OK?
